name: Couch Stretch
steps: Kneel facing away from a wall with one shin upright against the wall and your other foot planted flat in front.
Squeeze the glute on the kneeling side, tuck your pelvis slightly, and bring your torso upright.
Hold the stretch along the front of your rear hip and thigh while breathing evenly.
Ease forward to release, then switch legs and repeat.
tips: Move your rear knee farther from the wall if you need less knee bend.
Keep your lower ribs down instead of arching your lower back to get upright.
